timing: Fixed before running the new auxiliary-budget audit; existing file and prior manuscript results were already inspected.
purpose: Test the practical occurrence of losing a finite compensated logit estimate when the auxiliary pool expands under an existing variance power rule.
permutation: Reuse the first 500 source-convention permutations of 240 five-row blocks. These blocks are not verified participant IDs.
pilot: Mean human logistic loss plus squared coefficient norm divided by twice the human label count, including every fitted coordinate. The pilot is held fixed across N.
predictor: Use the existing five-fold ridge nuisance routine at each human label allocation, retaining all fallbacks. Freeze its row predictions across auxiliary budgets. No auxiliary human choice is used in this routine or in the compensated criterion.
power_rule: The unchanged source-style pooled-information power_weight function, using the fixed finite ridge pilot. Fixed-first-N power is the N=50 result held across all subsequent pools.
primary_outputs: all finite-to-exterior and exterior-to-finite paired transitions
original-loss recession directions for every exterior objective
ordinary human overlap or separation checks
precision_diagnostics: Report both the pooled source quadratic trace and a PSD sample-covariance trace of labelled corrected scores plus auxiliary prediction scores at the fixed pilot. These are estimated diagnostics; neither is actual conditional risk or valid high-dimensional inference.
independent_verification: Reconstruct every record and saved direction from the pinned numeric release; independently solve a preselected every-25th-allocation interval LP on every positive-power path, and every apparent positive-power boundary case. Check every primary exterior direction in the directly expressed original loss.
inference_scope: Conditional on the released file and block convention. The Gaussian population phase law does not apply to these fitted categorical predictions.
if_no_practical_degradation: Retain the null/adverse result and limit practical claims; do not select a different grid merely to obtain the desired effect.
innovation_scope: A practical test of the current objective and theorem consequence. No new power tuning rule, support theorem or causal study is proposed.
